objective: Accept a signed non-executable portable neural token-plan cake whose declarative tokenizer maps named supplied UTF-8 fields to stable source positions, and execute it through DirectCakeHost without receiver learning.
implementation_constraints: no ABI acquisition implementation, source-model code, teacher data, or ABI evidence in LayerCake
strict sorted field schema and fixed field width
missing, extra, duplicate, empty, oversized, or malformed fields fail closed
tokenizer format and semantic hash fail closed
signed package tensor payload loads strictly and remains immutable
DirectCakeHost lifecycle and persistent incremental execution remain authoritative
external_artifact_gate: A separately frozen artifact must cross the real package boundary and pass its own provenance, quality, causality, portability, and performance protocols.
